import re, glob, os, sys
base = "/tmp/r2run-b8tbnfr3/data/text"
rows = []
issues = []
for path in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(base, "*.txt"))):
    txt = open(path, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read()
    pages = re.split(r"^=== page \d+\s*$", txt, flags=re.M)
    for pi, pg in enumerate(pages):
        if "Case Number" not in pg:
            continue
        cn = re.search(r"Case\s*Number:\s*(\S+)", pg)
        resp = re.search(r"Respondent:\s*(.*?)\s*Other Party", pg, re.S)
        date = re.search(r"Date of Advisory Meeting:\s*([\d/]+)", pg)
        cites = re.findall(r"IC\s*8-1-26-[^\s\n]*", pg)
        rec = re.search(r"recommends the following civil penalty:\s*(.*?)(?:Abstentions|Additional Information|APPROVED|$)", pg, re.S)
        recs = rec.group(1) if rec else None
        rows.append(dict(file=os.path.basename(path), case=cn.group(1) if cn else None,
            resp=re.sub(r"\s+"," ",resp.group(1)).strip() if resp else None,
            cites=cites, rec=re.sub(r"\s+"," ",recs).strip() if recs else None,
            date=date.group(1) if date else None))
print(len(rows))
import collections
print(collections.Counter(len(r['cites']) for r in rows))
print("no rec:", sum(1 for r in rows if r['rec'] is None))
print("no case:", sum(1 for r in rows if not r['case']))
print("no resp:", sum(1 for r in rows if not r['resp']))
print("no date:", sum(1 for r in rows if not r['date']))
import json
json.dump(rows, open(os.path.join(os.environ['TMPDIR'],'q','rows.json'),'w'), indent=1)
EOF

import re, glob, os, collections
base = "/tmp/r2run-b8tbnfr3/data/text"
RX_REC = re.compile(r"recommends\s+the\s+following\s+civil\s+penalty", re.I)
STOP = re.compile(r"Abstentions|Additional\s+Information|APPROVED\s*:|Ben Warren, Chairman|Scott Sontag, (Vice )?Chairman", re.I)
forms = []
for path in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(base, "*.txt"))):
    txt = open(path, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read()
    pages = re.split(r"^=== page \d+\s*$", txt, flags=re.M)
    for pg in pages:
        m = RX_REC.search(pg)
        if not m:
            continue
        seg = pg[m.end():]
        s = STOP.search(seg)
        rec = seg[:s.start()] if s else seg
        rec = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", rec).strip()
        forms.append((os.path.basename(path), rec))
print("forms:", len(forms))
def headline(rec):
    # doubled $ allowed; thousands separators may be followed by a space
    m = re.search(r"\$+\s*(\d[\d,]*(?:,\s*\d{3})*|\d+)", rec)
    if not m:
        return 0
    return int(re.sub(r"[,\s]", "", m.group(1)))
pen = [(f, r, headline(r)) for f, r in forms]
pos = [x for x in pen if x[2] > 0]
tr = [x for x in pos if re.search(r"training", x[1], re.I)]
print("zero-penalty:", len(pen)-len(pos), "positive:", len(pos), "with training:", len(tr))
print("pct:", round(100*len(tr)/len(pos), 1), round(100*len(tr)/len(pos), 3))
print("recs containing 'train' but not 'training':", [x[1] for x in forms if re.search(r"train", x[1], re.I) and not re.search(r"training", x[1], re.I)][:20])
print("empty recs:", sum(1 for f,r in forms if not r))
print("no-$ recs sample:", collections.Counter(r for f,r,p in pen if p==0).most_common(15))
print("distinct rec texts with positive penalty & training (sample):", collections.Counter(r for f,r,p in tr).most_common(8))
EOF
